746880101.text: These results are far, far better than expected!

746880102.text: Even a whole company couldn't take out as many monsters as you! Based on the current situation, there's no way those monsters can escape the ruins.

746880103.text: How do you feel? Was it hard work?

746880105.text: Urgh, yeah. Those muzzle flashes aren't super bright, but Paimon still got dizzy from staring at them for too long...

746880106.text: No problem! A paper I once read mentioned that you can suppress the flash by installing a device at the end of the barrel. It helps lower visual fatigue when firing for long periods.

746880110.text: Anyway, the crisis has been averted, and we've collected enough data to ensure the next version of my cannon will be even better!

746880111.text: I can't thank you enough for your help, Proto-Boss — and, of course, for that of your little assistant!

746880112.text: And lest we forget the vital role you played, Miss Marine... The reward money has already been earmarked for our Proto-Boss, but once I've sold the cannon, I'll split the proceeds with you — fifty-fifty!

746880113.text: Huh? You want to split the money with me!?

746880114.text: I don't care much for Mora, but I wouldn't say no to some fermented Tidalga... and it needs to be wheat-based alcohol, none of that fruity nonsense.

746880115.text: Paimon hasn't tried fermented Tidalga before, but it sounds like it's worth a try...

746880108.text: Paimon feels like there's a flock of seagulls screaming inside her head!

746880109.text: I have a solution for that! An abandoned engineering project I read mentioned using a multi-chambered muzzle device to slow down the gases responsible for the noise and make the cannon quieter. Unfortunately, the materials required are quite expensive...
